config.notes:
Voxel metrics, not skeleton ones: these volumes ship dense label arrays and no skeletons, so panoptic
quality ranks. A FAST eval: every volume is a centred 512^3 crop of its measured region, so its scores
are not comparable with lmd_ssl_v2_neuron_instance's or any published number (pq moves with the extent
scored). Use it to rank checkpoints against each other, and confirm a ranking on the full eval.

Scored region per volume is mia-train predict.py's lattice-aligned sub-box of the cropped box, at 8 nm:
0.66 G voxels on the reported half, 0.60 G on the fit half.
